gem5_model.interpretation: A 32 MiB modeled logical aperture/backing; it is not the 512 KiB hardware shared-SRAM capacity.

diagnostic.rejected_hypothesis: Gem5 LDU adds a fixed 0x4000 source-address bias.
diagnostic.root_cause: An i16 vload received a byte count of 16384 as its element count, requested 32768 bytes, and wrapped/overwrote the 16384-byte physical VRF.
positive_explanation: vload base 0x8000 reads 0x8000..0xffff; the 0xc000..0xffff half overwrites the first half.
vload base 0x4000 reads 0x4000..0xbfff; the 0x8000..0xbfff half overwrites the first half.
diagnostic.required_fix: Use the raw descriptor LDU offset and 8192 i16 elements for a 16384-byte payload; keep vreturn length at 16384 bytes.

scalar_access_contract.finding: The raw descriptor payload offset is an LDU/STU offset and is not proven to be a directly dereferenceable scalar C address in the current Gem5 process mapping.
scalar_access_contract.gate: Freeze and probe an explicit scalar external-L2 mapping, or keep payload access on Venus LDU/STU.

authority_conflict.active_configured_mapping: The generated cluster0 memory wrapper and AXI fabric derive shared SRAM base 0x80008000 from program size 0x8000.
authority_conflict.stale_or_unresolved_mapping: hardware/soc_hierachy/venus_soc_pkg.sv names local L2 base 0x80020000 and global base 0x20020000.
authority_conflict.rule: Do not choose a universal address or bias until manifest and hardware-address authority are resolved.
